hypothesis: Reading a file through an already-open file handle (fs.promises.FileHandle) closes the js/file-system-race window that CodeQL reports on the lock's contended path.
refutedBy: The alert is about the check-then-use pair, not about which API performs the read. Routing the read through a handle obtained AFTER the existence check leaves the same TOCTOU window -- the handle is opened by path at the same moment the plain read would have been. The alert survives the change because the defect survives it.
surface: CodeQL js/file-system-race on the lock acquire path
witness: The js/file-system-race alert is still reported on the rewritten path; it clears only when the check is dropped and the open's own ENOENT is interpreted instead.
